description: The file is a Python test configuration script that sets up shared fixtures for testing a FastAPI application with an in-memory SQLite database, including user registration, authentication, and task creation. It provides environment setup, database initialization, and API client fixtures for testing.

methods.name: Generator[None,None,None] _using_inmemory_db()
methods.description: Context manager to override the database URL to an in-memory SQLite database with StaticPool, set up the engine, and create tables.

methods.name: Iterable[None] inmemory_db_session_scope()
methods.description: Session-scoped fixture that initializes and tears down the in-memory database for all tests in the session.

methods.name: Generator[TestClient,None,None] client(inmemory_db_session_scope)
